definitions.gloss: short trip; excursion; day trip; outing
definitions.explanation: A brief trip or outing, typically lasting a day or a weekend, as opposed to a longer vacation. Often used for casual leisure outings to nearby destinations.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}に{小旅行|しょうりょこう}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went on a short trip over the weekend.

examples.japanese: {日帰|ひがえ}りの{小旅行|しょうりょこう}で{温泉|おんせん}に{入|はい}ってきた。
examples.english: I took a day trip and visited a hot spring.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{休|やす}みは{取|と}れないけれど、{近場|ちかば}への{小旅行|しょうりょこう}なら{気軽|きがる}に{楽|たの}しめる。
examples.english: I can't take a long vacation, but I can easily enjoy a short trip to somewhere nearby.

notes:
USAGE: {小旅行|しょうりょこう} emphasizes the brevity of the trip. It is a compound of {小|しょう} (small, short) and {旅行|りょこう} (trip, travel).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小旅行|しょうりょこう}に{行|い}く: to go on a short trip
- {日帰|ひがえ}りの{小旅行|しょうりょこう}: a day trip
- {週末|しゅうまつ}の{小旅行|しょうりょこう}: a weekend getaway
- {小旅行|しょうりょこう}を{楽|たの}しむ: to enjoy an excursion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小旅行|しょうりょこう}: short trip, day trip
- {旅行|りょこう}: trip, travel (general)
- {遠足|えんそく}: excursion, field trip (school context)
